calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.1(2), an ancillary building may be used for living accommodation in one laneway suite.
calculation_handling.gaps: Use permission; the one-building limit is carried by 150.8.20.1(2).

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.1(3), an ancillary building may have both food preparation and sanitary facilities in a laneway suite.
Despite 150.5.60.1(1), a home occupation is permitted in a laneway suite exclusively and separately occupied as a principal residence, applying Section 150.5 as if it is a dwelling unit.
calculation_handling.gaps: Home occupation is a use outside MaxBLD scope with no vocab use token.

units.disclosure: A home business is allowed in a laneway suite that is someone's principal residence; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 150.13.20.1(1), a short-term rental is permitted in an ancillary building if it is in a laneway suite exclusively and separately occupied as a principal residence.
calculation_handling.gaps: Short-term rental is a use outside MaxBLD scope with no vocab use token.

units.disclosure: A short-term rental is allowed in a laneway suite that is someone's principal residence; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.1(4), above-ground parts of an ancillary building containing a laneway suite may be erected before the main walls and roof of the residential building on the same lot are complete.
calculation_handling.gaps: Construction sequencing permission; no envelope effect.

calculation_handling.description: A maximum of one ancillary building containing either a laneway suite or a garden suite is permitted on a lot, and a lot may not contain both a laneway suite and a garden suite.
calculation_handling.gaps: The count is of suite buildings (laneway or garden) on the lot, not principal buildings. The second sentence (not both) is a prohibition carried in the same unit; it follows from the one-building limit when each suite is in its own building.

150.8.20.1(1).explanation: A laneway suite may be a home in an accessory building with its own kitchen and bathroom; it may host a home business or short-term rental if it is someone's principal residence, and it may be built before the main house is finished.

150.8.20.1(2).explanation: A lot can have only one suite building, either a laneway suite or a garden suite, never both.
